## Activity

River Outreach recorded 55 captures during June 2024. Capture activity continued across the reporting period, with session lists managed as planned apart from routine leave. The recorded activity provides the basis for the image-quality and grading results below. No change to the reporting approach is noted in the available information.

## Image quality

Image quality was sufficient for grading in most cases. A total of 5 captures were ungradable, representing an ungradable rate of 9.1. These images were excluded from grading outcomes because they could not be assessed reliably. The result should continue to be monitored through routine site review, with attention to any recurring causes of ungradable images.

## Grading

Grading identified 6 referable results from the captures assessed. The median lag between capture and grading was 3. This provides the current summary measure for reporting turnaround at River Outreach. Overall, the results record the volume of activity, the proportion of images that could not be graded, the number of referable findings, and the time taken for grading during June 2024.
